<!-- ================= HOW I WORK (full-width band) ================= -->
<div class="process-band column-screen">
<div class="vb-section">
<p class="eyebrow">How I work</p>
<h2>From the decision to a measured result</h2>
<div class="process-grid">
<div class="process-step"><div class="process-head"><span class="process-num">01</span><h4>Frame</h4></div><p class="process-lead">What decision does this serve?</p><ul><li>Determine if model is the right lever</li><li>Name the target outcome before picking the method</li></ul></div>
<div class="process-step"><div class="process-head"><span class="process-num">02</span><h4>Measure</h4></div><p class="process-lead">Agree how we measure it</p><p>North star, guardrail and launch bar, agreed before anything is built.</p></div>
<div class="process-step"><div class="process-head"><span class="process-num">03</span><h4>Build and Evaluate</h4></div><p class="process-lead">Test rigorously</p><ul><li>Offline evaluation first, calibrated to human judgment</li><li>Live test with decision rules set up front</li></ul></div>
<div class="process-step"><div class="process-head"><span class="process-num">04</span><h4>Decide</h4></div><p class="process-lead">Own the outcome</p><p>Own the readout and the call that follows: scale it, change it, or stop it.</p></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<p class="about-role">Applied AI &amp; ML leader · London</p>
<p>I've spent more than eleven years working where machine learning directly drives business decisions—determining what to bid for a hotel click, which listing a shopper sees, or whether an LLM's output is safe to show a customer.</p>
<p>I started in software engineering and operations research, which is why I care just as much about the commercial decision a system serves as the model itself. I do my best work leading lean teams on deep problems that matter to the business, and I still review the architecture, the evaluations and the code myself.</p>
<p>Alongside that, I consult independently through Vihive Labs and build with multi-agent systems and LLM evaluation. Outside work: cricket with Croydon Cricket Club, travel and hiking.</p>
